profile.headline: Software Engineer - System Architect at Argo AI
profile.summary:
Driven system/software architect and full stack ADAS software engineer with 10+ years’ experience in automotive industry deploying ADAS systems with parking and driving sensors configurations including independent and fusion based systems. Major experiences include leading and deploying of Automatic Parking Assist, Adaptive Cruise Control, and Automatic Emergency Braking functions through entire V-model life-cycle with global team and stakeholders.

Experience working with ultrasonic, radar, and front video camera sensor interfaces integration in different perception software stacks.

Experience deploying systems with different middleware frameworks such as classic AUTOSAR, ROS, etc... Proven track record of challenging the status quo by deploying improvements such as
- model based design in Simulink and other continuous improvement topics
- DXL scripting of DOORs modules for automated checklist
- Linux bash scripting to automate deployment of ROS framework on vehicle computer

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Responsible for XCP architecture for Autonomous Vehicle System (AVS) and Complementary Autonomous Vehicle System (CAVS) in Argo AI’s Self Driving System (SDS) System Architecture.

positions.title: Technical Specialist - System Architect
positions.description:
Lead System/Software Architect for multi system on chip vehicle computer.

- Ensure alignment and deployment of customer's architecture and requirements to internal and external stakeholders (Radar, Ultrasonic, Front Video, Surround Video, Driver Monitoring, and One Compute Teams)
- Design and deploy rapid prototype of 5 radar 1 video perception fusion system on Linux based PC running Robot Operating System

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
System Architect for Driver Assistance team

- Align, design, and deploy different driver assistance systems with different sensor sets
   - 5 radar 1 video sensor configuration on a driver assistance vehicle computer
   - 1 radar standalone ECU
- Develop, design, and propose MATLAB Simulink based approach for the function state machines to streamline development process for customer specific changes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior System/Software Architect for Ultrasonic Parking Assist ECU

- Lead all aspects of the agile based development process
- Interview, mentor, and lead the fast growing system and software team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
System and software technical lead for Ultrasonic Parking Assist ECU

- Architect reusable customer platform that was deployed to multiple projects
- Lead all aspects of V-model based development process
- Lead retrofit and deployment of a generation 5 to first generation 6 ultrasonic system in North America to demo fully autonomous for an acquisition demo
- Lead team while executing different roles such as System/Software Architect, Application/Base Software Developer, and Software Integrator

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded Software Engineer for Rear View Camera ECU

- Worked on the I2C, LIN, and EEPROM drivers and other base software related topics
- Support all steps of the V Model Software Development process
- Requirements elicitation, customer coordination and negotiation, software configuration manager, platform software development

positions.title: Product Engineer Software
positions.description:
Application Software Developer for Electronic Stability Control modules

- Unified Diagnostic Services and Failure Management function owner

positions.title: Help Desk Support Technician
positions.description:
- Workstation & laptop maintenance, repair, software updates & patches
- Cisco administrator (VOIP, voicemail, meeting place, etc…)
- Microsoft server administration (Active Directory, Exchange, 2003, 2008, etc…)
- Blackberry phone and server administration
- LAN setup and troubleshooting
- Data backup (VERITAS NetBackup, Norton Ghost, etc…)

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
- Website Developer
- Graphic Design
- Database Management
- Video Editing
